ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly black pigmentation on the lateral margins and trailing edges. Central lobe regions feature large, irregularly shaped white contiguous zones heavily interspersed with black linear and punctate mottling. Small, high-contrast white circular spots with dark centroids are scattered across the pigmented regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression; vertex is submerged, but the upper visible angle is approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged serration across the continuous trailing edge. Notable macroscopic indentations (missing tissue/chips) are localized on the upper section of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trajectory follows a convex curve sweeping from the central notch area toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity, textured barnacle colonization are located at both distal tips. Distinct, isolated circular white ring scars with dark centers are visible on the mid-lateral sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High density of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white central zones, predominantly oriented in vertical and diagonal directions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle encrustation on the distal tips. Macroscopic irregular notches or tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe. Extensive superficial rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'bullseye' markers (dark circular core within a white high-intensity ring) located in the lower-central region of the left lobe.
